scope: Combined review candidate, not changes to immutable native records

findings.reason: Both source configurations use the same topic address. Matching names/logical IDs do not by themselves establish the same broker/profile/deployed destination. Keep declarations distinct until environment/transport correspondence is established; do not count record identities as a census of deployed components.
findings.requiredEvidence: Broker/profile/source configuration correspondence and message/schema compatibility before any delivery binding.

applicationAdoptionGates: Historical/current registrations and internal processor views need distinct catalogue projections

Large endpoint expansion can exhaust control node budget before an outbound call is reached; an empty partial interaction view is not an absence claim. CaaS unsealed CreateRuleset is the current reproducer. A future hierarchical/source-dependency projection must declare its reachability/feasibility semantics separately from bounded path interactions.
